findings.title: Evidence return loses comparison position
findings.statement: Returning from claim evidence resets the selected comparison facet and scroll anchor.

severity.rationale: Users must reconstruct comparison context during a critical verification journey.

confidence.basis: Direct browser exercise reproduced the loss on every return.

findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Comparison state is not represented in restorable navigation state.

recommendation.action: Preserve the selected facet and scroll anchor across evidence drill-down and return.
alternatives: Open evidence without replacing comparison context.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Returning from evidence restores the selected facet and prior scroll anchor.

verification_method.procedure: Select a facet, record the anchor, open evidence, return, and assert both values are restored.

evidence.exact_observation: Browser Back returned to the route with default facet and top scroll position.

flow_recommendation.intent: Verify a comparison claim and return without reconstruction.
flow_recommendation.required_behavior: Evidence drill-down and return preserve selected facet and scroll anchor.
flow_recommendation.return_path: Browser Back or explicit return restores the exact prior comparison state.
